name: 完整对话：准确上下文回答、混合候选筛选、混合候选回答
retrieval: Fixed original-question source-BM25Top5 and MiniLM384vectorTop5, union dedup, full raw conversations, chronological order. Rankings are frozen controls; do not rerank when testing another model.
reproducibility: All three model tasks and existing scores can be replayed using this folder alone. Re-sampling a model is a new recorded run, not guaranteed byte-identical output. Frozen retrieval replay requires no embeddings or index server; from-scratch embedding/index reconstruction is a different experiment.

main_metrics.oracle_answer: Correct complete answers /23clear cases; retain original-reference content match /25 and ambiguity notes.
main_metrics.candidate_select: Questions whose selected sources contain all36registered evidence needs, with no confirmed unrelated picks; /25questions. Unknown nonreference picks require source review.
main_metrics.candidate_answer: Correct complete answers /23clear cases, compared to same models oracle baseline; keep source/quote/entailment diagnostics separate.

caveats: 25previously-known public English positives, not new blind test or broad model ranking.
No natural no-answer queries; unrelated-pick fraction is not global false-positive rate.
Semantic labels by parent researcher, not independent external human review.
One first sample per input; model availability and sampling can change.
Some source overlaps are redundant historical records; missing every reference source is not mandatory-evidence failure.
